description: Get total sales by region for Q3 2024
pyspark_query:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

df = spark.table('sales')
result = df.filter(
    (F.col('date') >= '2024-07-01') & (F.col('date') <= '2024-09-30')
).groupBy('region').agg(
    F.sum('amount').alias('total_sales')
)
result.show()

description: Find customers who have not placed any order in the last 90 days
pyspark_query:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

customers = spark.table('customers')
orders = spark.table('orders')
cutoff = (datetime.now() - timedelta(days=90)).strftime('%Y-%m-%d')

recent_buyers = orders.filter(F.col('order_date') >= cutoff).select('customer_id').distinct()
inactive = customers.join(recent_buyers, on='customer_id', how='left_anti')
inactive.show()

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

df = spark.table('revenue')
monthly = df.groupBy(F.date_trunc('month', F.col('date')).alias('month')).agg(
    F.sum('amount').alias('revenue')
)
w = Window.orderBy('month')
result = monthly.withColumn('prev_revenue', F.lag('revenue').over(w)).withColumn(
    'growth_rate', (F.col('revenue') - F.col('prev_revenue')) / F.col('prev_revenue') * 100
)
result.show()

description: Get top 10 products by number of returns in 2024
pyspark_query:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

df = spark.table('returns')
result = df.filter(F.year(F.col('return_date')) == 2024).groupBy('product_id', 'product_name').agg(
    F.count('*').alias('return_count')
).orderBy(F.desc('return_count')).limit(10)
result.show()

description: Join orders with customer demographics and get average order value by age group
pyspark_query:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

orders = spark.table('orders')
customers = spark.table('customers')

joined = orders.join(customers, on='customer_id')
result = joined.withColumn(
    'age_group',
    F.when(F.col('age') < 25, '18-24')
     .when(F.col('age') < 35, '25-34')
     .when(F.col('age') < 45, '35-44')
     .when(F.col('age') < 55, '45-54')
     .otherwise('55+')
).groupBy('age_group').agg(
    F.avg('order_amount').alias('avg_order_value')
)
result.show()
